Every loan option has a gain of 0 and a negative net (-2.1 oz or worse). Radio and CMMS agree, so there is no confirmation to request. No loans.

LH-08 comes from a cheap development heading and is the best net option at +28.8 oz. C512-10: LH-01 should clear its 140 t alone after repair (likely 13:20), so every loan there nets zero or negative. No loan there.
